statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Reopened delayed NQ is near flat with only a narrow initial range visible, so there is no verified persistent one-way path; payroll and elevated energy/geopolitical risk keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The next material path checkpoint is the reaction after the 12:30 UTC Employment Situation; Tail would rise only if observed price discovery becomes persistently directional with shallow or failed retracements.
headline: Tail normalizes to low overnight; payrolls remain the dominant conditional risk window
body: Delayed NQ reopened around 29,504, roughly 0.07% below the prior close, with only an initial narrow print visible. Fresh shared context collected at 00:28 UTC showed 7 of 8 tracked megacaps positive but mixed semiconductor confirmation; oil and U.S.-Iran risk remain significant Stress amplifiers, and the August Employment Situation is due at 12:30 UTC.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock-hours, Tail began low, moved to WATCH around the U.S. event and opening window, became elevated during the late technology-led rally, then returned to WATCH after the close. The newest reopened delayed NQ print is near flat, supporting a further normalization in current Tail.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is low because the reopened delayed NQ print is near flat and does not show persistent extension. Stress remains extreme into payrolls. Forecast Tail stays at or below WATCH before the release and becomes elevated afterward only conditionally if observed price discovery shows persistent extension, shallow or failed retracements, and aligned confirmation.

forecast.analysis: Thin overnight liquidity can exaggerate moves, but a single extension is not enough to establish Tail risk. Repeated failure of retracements would be needed to shift the assessment away from normal.

Approaching the Asia-to-Europe handoff, cross-session persistence becomes more informative. Tail remains low unless direction survives the liquidity transition and begins holding near an overnight extreme.
At the early European handoff, broader participation can reveal whether overnight direction is durable. Two-sided rotation would keep Tail low despite the approaching U.S. labor report.
European liquidity is expected to deepen. Tail remains low unless price holds near an extreme while pullbacks repeatedly fail and cross-asset confirmation strengthens in the same direction.
As Europe becomes established, event sensitivity rises but pre-release outcomes are not assumed. Ordinary counter-moves would keep Tail below WATCH even if Stress remains extreme.
The U.S. morning approaches and Tail moves to WATCH because liquidity and positioning sensitivity increase. The event itself does not establish a pathological path before it is published.

forecast.analysis: The first post-release hour is conditionally elevated: Tail rises only if the observed reaction persists with shallow or failed retracements and aligned cross-asset confirmation. Orderly two-sided discovery would argue for a faster drop.

The U.S. cash open adds a second liquidity shock after payrolls. Elevated Tail is conditional on an opening-auction continuation that holds near an extreme instead of producing meaningful counter-swings.
By the second cash-session hour, elevated Tail requires continued directional efficiency after both payrolls and the open. A deeper retracement or fading volatility would support normalization.
If the post-release path becomes two-sided by mid-session, Tail can fall back to WATCH even while Stress remains high. Continued extreme-holding would delay that normalization.
Later U.S. trading should reveal whether the event impulse is decaying. Tail remains at WATCH if counter-swings return and cross-asset pressure becomes less uniformly aligned.
By early afternoon in New York, the baseline favors mixed rather than one-way structure. Tail stays at WATCH unless the market renews extension after failed retracements.
With the release further behind, volatility decay and ordinary rotations would reduce path risk. Persistent session-extreme holding would be the main reason for Tail to remain at WATCH.
Late-session positioning can create renewed movement, but Tail remains WATCH unless that movement becomes persistent and retracement-resistant across multiple checks.
Into the cash close, Tail can return to low if the session has shown meaningful two-sided discovery. A closing drive pinned near an extreme would be the principal contrary signal.
After the cash close, lower liquidity usually reduces the evidentiary value of short bursts. Tail stays low unless there is a fresh geopolitical discontinuity or unusually persistent futures move.
During the evening futures session, normal retracements would keep Tail low. Residual Stress remains elevated because energy and geopolitical headlines can still produce abrupt repricing.
By the final forecast hour, the baseline is low Tail with high residual Stress. Any renewed escalation would require fresh observed path evidence before being treated as a persistent Tail regime.
